headline: Anthropic IPO talk at $2 trillion; Nvidia aces ARC-AGI-3 public levels
body: A modest day. The New York Times reported bankers have floated an Anthropic IPO raising more than $100 billion at a $2 trillion valuation, another sign of Power Concentration, which nudged Enslaved God and Benevolent Dictator up. Brazil's split sovereign-supercomputer bet on Huawei and Nvidia pulled the other way, deliberately avoiding dependence on one vendor. Nvidia's agent harness scored 100 on public ARC-AGI-3 levels, adding to Capability Velocity, and OpenAI asked California to require monitoring during training, a small plus for Alignment & Control. Horizon Balance edged up to -4.19.
movers_note: Enslaved God +0.2 from the Anthropic IPO report (+0.14) and Nvidia's ARC-AGI-3 result (+0.08), less Brazil (-0.09); Protector God +0.1 from ARC-AGI-3 (+0.07) and OpenAI's SB 53 push (+0.06).
coming_up: Possible Anthropic IPO in October, as floated by bankers
